prompts.prompt:
Create ONE production master illustration for Our World, not a concept sheet, no text. Use maximum supported landscape resolution, ideally 3072x2048 or larger, and use a wide landscape canvas. Full opaque room painting.
REFERENCES: A1-keyart = approved room, warm lamp LEFT, big rain city window, wooden table, record player RIGHT, painterly light/material/detail lock. CH-mirror RIGHT half only = relationship and identity: male partner across table, viewer cream knit sleeves foreground. CH-ayu-sheet = original male identity lock. Golden and blue-hour references = same approved painting quality only, NOT current lighting.
STYLE EXACTLY MATCH references: high-end 2D anime CG gacha key visual; semi-realistic anime, delicate fine line art, soft cel shading plus painterly gradients, warm subsurface skin, finely detailed dark navy-black tousled hair, practical warm light from LEFT lamp and cool blue window rim, bloom, bokeh and depth. NOT photoreal, NOT chibi, NOT 3D render. Original characters. No halos, glowing outlines, circles or markers.
CAMERA / GEOMETRY: viewer Xiaoman seated at a small wooden table looking straight across at Ayu. Single frontal symmetrical camera, level horizon, no tilted camera. TABLE FAR EDGE must be one straight horizontal line across frame near 63% height, torso emerges behind that line, forearms rest on tabletop. Ayu centered, half body, head top at about 8% height. Important props completely within 4% safety margin (foreground sleeves may enter bottom edge naturally). Big rectangular window with straight vertical mullions behind him, believable simple wooden chair back behind his torso. Keep same warm intimate approved reference room.
SUBJECT: Ayu exactly matching sheet, thin round glasses, charcoal hoodie, navy-black messy hair, calm warm subtle smile, glancing slightly down at the pages of an open paperback held in BOTH hands, forearms on table. Hands anatomically clean. His own blue-gray ceramic mug stands separately on HIS side, to camera-right of his book.
FOREGROUND: bottom center viewer's TWO feminine hands in oversized CREAM KNIT CARDIGAN sleeves holding a ceramic mug, same relationship as right half CH-mirror. Mug rim and hands readable, sleeves softly out of focus.
LEFT: fabric pleated shade table lamp ON, slender brass stem, with ONE thin metal pull chain visibly hanging from under shade right side. Two closed books on table by lamp. Do not add candles (off state must have no warm room source). RIGHT: walnut record player fully inside frame, hinged lid OPEN upright, a vinyl record on platter, spindle and a visible tonearm, enough room to measure elliptical platter. Face-DOWN polaroid (plain pale back, no dark photo image) on table near player.
BACKGROUND: rainy NIGHT city skyline across river, rain streaks on glass, faint low contrast reflections only, no reflected people. A few foliage accents like approved room. Intimate small room, no extra people. The male is the only visible face. Production master will be edited into empty room plates, so keep furniture geometrically simple and clearly placed.

EDIT the attached master illustration. Preserve its exact identity, exquisite painted anime CG style, room furnishings, rainy night and lamp warm/cool lighting, but CORRECT THE FRAMING for a production asset. Output ONE landscape PNG at maximum available native landscape size; 1536x1024 if that is the available maximum. Do NOT simply repeat existing crop.
Camera pulls BACK enough to frame the full left lamp and full right record player with comfortable margins. Topmost hair at exactly 8% canvas height, not touching top. Keep partner center, full head and shoulders, hands and book. Reduce overall subject and furniture size to roughly 80% of current relative scale, expanding room around them. Full lamp shade must be at least 4% away from left border. Full record player including entire open lid and base must fit before x=95% width, with entire record visible. FRONT facing table far edge is a perfectly straight horizontal line at about y=65%, visible beside torso; torso behind edge with forearms resting over it.
Ayu's eyes must look SLIGHTLY DOWN at the open paperback in both hands rather than look directly at viewer. Keep navy black tousled hair, thin round glasses, charcoal hoodie, warm subtle smile. Viewer foreground cream knit sleeves and two hands around floral mug remain centered entering bottom naturally.
Simple wooden chair back behind Ayu. Remove any candle flames or secondary glowing lamps from the room, including upper-right background candle; only practical left lamp and cool city light. Keep TWO closed books at left (not three), one held book, one face-down polaroid right, partner mug camera-right of book. Left shade thin metal pull chain intact, record and tonearm intact. No added objects, no text, no annotations, no halos. Rain glass reflections subdued, no people reflections. This is the final full-scene look master from which geometry will be locked.
